chapter: Brownlee band, dances and the Frolic
title: The Frolic, Frank Pattengill and the steamer President
summary: Sharkey's band opened the Frolic, then the Top Hat, Pattengill opened a 25-cent club, and Fad Marable's band played the river boat.
